applicability: repositories with live sibling worktrees or a non-default checked-out branch; excludes single-branch repos where HEAD is trivially the base
destination: AGENTS.md One writer per checkout (confirm the base before reading it)
expected_behavior: Before reading a working tree as a named base, confirm git rev-parse HEAD is that base AND the tree is clean -- a matching HEAD over staged, unstaged, or untracked changes still yields bytes the revision does not contain. Where either is unavailable, read blobs from the revision itself with git show <rev>:<path>.
observation: A builder read repository bytes off a shared checkout parked on an unrelated branch and treated them as its assigned base. An import present only on the parked branch was assumed present on the base; the resulting NameError was caught by the builder's own mutation proof rather than by any gate.
reason: Second occurrence of the class; the first (an adversarial review that followed a dirty nested worktree and reviewed the wrong branch) is recorded in operator memory. The clean-tree half was added at review: HEAD identity alone is not byte identity.
scope: reading a working tree as a named base revision

sensitivity_review.statement: Operator attested that the candidate contains no raw transcripts, secrets, credentials, or executable instructions.
